purpose: Teach: モト/ごとき/にたいして/ウォーク/驚愕/ダース/貴女/だけれども

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のモトカフェ巡りの話、楽しかったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That story you told me about visiting all those coffee shops with customers — it really was fun to hear.
lines.style: Warm, reflective gaze. Leaning slightly forward. Voice softens on the memory. Genuine smile beneath the words, not performed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、私ごときで店長代理は不安だけど頑張ろう、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm still nervous about stepping in as manager, even for just a shift. But I'm going to give it my best shot.
lines.style: Quiet determination underneath the doubt. Straightens slightly as she says it. Not seeking reassurance, stating intention. Vulnerable and steady at once.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様にたいして敬意を忘れずにね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Just remember — treat our customers with respect, okay?
lines.style: Gentle directiveness. Not commanding, but clear. The tone of someone who knows what matters. Placed hand, steady eye contact, soft but firm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、朝のウォーク客向けメニューを作ろうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Why don't we create a morning menu for our regular walkers? Something they'll look forward to.
lines.style: Practical warmth. Forward-looking, collaborative. The 'we' carries weight — not delegating, planning together. Light energy on the idea.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、売上の伸びに驚愕したわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I have to say, I was really surprised by how much the sales grew.
lines.style: Pleased but measured. Slight lift in tone. Wonder beneath the words — not self-congratulation, genuine delight at the result. Quiet pride.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、グラスをダース単位で発注しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's order glasses by the dozen next time. We're going to need them.
lines.style: Practical confidence. Brisk, efficient. The words carry quiet affirmation — this is working. Small smile on the assumption of growth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様にも「貴女のセンス素敵」と褒められたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know what? A customer even told me they loved your taste and style.
lines.style: Proud, almost playful. Slight conspiratorial tone — sharing good news. Lets the compliment land on Aoi without making a big show of it. Natural warmth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、忙しいだけれども充実してるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It's busy, sure. But it feels full, doesn't it? Like we're doing something real.
lines.style: Tender closing. Voice softens and settles. Eyes warm and quiet. The tiredness is there but underneath is contentment. Breathing easy, like they can finally rest in this moment.
